_help: raw_data_dir is relative to this repo root. home_timezone is used for US plays and for plays detected as VPN/unknown country.

vpn_detection._help: Plays from vpn_countries are always treated as VPN (home timezone, excluded from trips). If auto is true, other short non-US runs with US plays within window_minutes on both sides are also treated as VPN (off by default: it misfires at trip edges).
